diagram_previews.alt: Three figures side by side: level 1 is an equilateral triangle; level 2 is the triangle with the triangle joining the midpoints of its sides drawn inside; level 3 repeats this in each of the three corner triangles of level 2.

Level 3 of the figure: the big triangle ABC with D, E, F the midpoints of BC, CA, AB; the three corner triangles AFE, FBD and EDC, shaded in different colours, each contain a copy of level 2, and the middle triangle DEF is outlined in red.
